skills.name: acme-workspace
skills.description: Read FIRST in any marketing task. How the team shares work through the marketing data pool: document IDs, tags and status for briefs, article drafts and social posts, and how to write a document safely (revision, request_id).

skills.name: acme-radar
skills.description: Read before a scan. How to read the sources your mission lists with web_search/web_fetch, keep few items, and merge them into today's brief in the acme-marketing pool.

skills.name: acme-write
skills.description: Read before writing. Turn a chosen angle into an article draft and channel-native social posts in the acme-marketing pool, with every product claim checked against knowledge_search.

skills.name: acme-review-publish
skills.description: Read before reviewing or publishing. The review checklist, how each channel goes live, when to stop and ask a person, and how to hand off what only a person can post.

skills.name: acme-post
skills.description: Read before posting from the browser. Post exactly the ready text of one social post on the account that is already logged in, then record the URL.
